rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken term for the cheek on the side of the face.

example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 min6 zyu1 hung4 saai3 wo3

rows.note: A speaker uses this vulgar colloquial noun for a buttock or butt cheek, especially when the body is exposed.

example.english: The swim trunks were too small, so half my butt cheek was exposed.
example.traditional: 游水嗰陣，條泳褲太細，露咗半邊屎忽。
example.jyutping: jau4 seoi2 go2 zan6 tiu4 wing6 fu3 taai3 sai3 lou6 zo2 bun3 bin1 si2 fat1

rows.note: A speaker uses this noun for shameless impudence, especially when someone has the nerve to ask for something outrageous.

example.english: They've got some cheek—still having the nerve to ask me for five thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 佢咁厚面皮，仲夠膽問我借五千蚊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 hau5 min6 pei4 zung6 gau3 daam2 man6 ngo5 ze3 ng5 cin1 man1
